content.text: Starting from May 25th, every data controller will have to comply with the strict data protection and data storage regulations of the GDPR. Although the Regulation is rigorous, with the professional help of our Firm your business will be GDPR compliant within the deadline, and will also be able to avoid the hefty, max. EUR 20M fines. Our lawyers have attended numerous GDPR-related courses and trainings in order to support our present and prospective Clients during the forthcoming compliance period. Contact our Team now!
